title: Measure boot duration and resident memory of the installed memory-fix build after the restart
outcome: Measure boot duration and resident memory of the installed memory-fix build after the restart
acceptance: After Greg's restart on the build that carries w-b3c1cd1bcea1, the boot duration and the host's resident memory are measured the same way and on the same host as the 'before' figures recorded on w-b3c1cd1bcea1, and both pairs of figures are recorded on this item with the build hash.
Any regression against the 'before' figures is reported to the TermAl coordinator with the numbers.
